name: assistant-ui
description: Skills for building AI chat interfaces with the assistant-ui React library

interface.shortDescription: Build AI chat UIs in React
interface.longDescription: Guides you through building AI chat interfaces with assistant-ui, the open-source React library for chat. Covers scaffolding a project with the CLI, choosing a runtime (Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, AG-UI, A2A, or a custom backend), composing the Thread, Composer, and Message primitives, registering tools with tool UI and approvals, generative UI, streaming, markdown rendering, multi-thread chat, Assistant Cloud persistence, React Native, a terminal UI with Ink, and upgrading between versions. The skills are written for developers who already work in TypeScript and React. They give guidance only: the plugin does not connect to an account, call an external service, or collect data, and it does not write code outside your project unless you ask it to.
defaultPrompt: Add an assistant-ui chat interface to my Next.js app.
Which assistant-ui runtime fits my LangGraph backend?
Upgrade my project to the latest assistant-ui.

publication.release_notes: Initial release for the ChatGPT plugin directory: 17 skills covering setup, runtimes, primitives, tools, generative UI, streaming, cloud, React Native, Ink, and upgrades.
